title: Covenant Logistics Group Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Covenant Logistics Group, Inc. (NYSE: CVLG) (“Covenant” or the “Company”) announced today that its board of directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share of Class A and Class B common stock. The quarterly cash dividend is payable to stockholders of record on December 4, 2026, and is expected to be paid on December 28, 2026.
